data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'hendros', meaning 'ruler' or 'protector'. In Christian tradition, Hendry is a strong and noble name, often given to boys who are expected to provide and protect. The name Hendry carries the meaning “Ruler, protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hendry usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
